lines.text: AI reads every word at once, so how does it know the word order?
The red fox jumps over the gray fox means something different from the gray fox jumping over the red one.
lines.title: Order changes meaning

lines.text: Early models added a position vector to each word. The original transformer used fixed sine and cosine waves.
lines.title: Older methods

lines.text: RoPE rotates each word's query and key numbers by an angle that depends on its position.
lines.title: How RoPE works

lines.text: Words two positions apart score the same whether they sit at the start of a text or after a hundred more words.
lines.title: Gap is what counts

lines.text: Newer designs rotate only some numbers, skip RoPE in some layers, or add a learned bias.
lines.title: Newer twists

lines.text: RoPE is still the most common choice, and the author expects it to stay that way into 2027.
lines.title: Takeaways
